news.headline: USC's Eric Gentry to redshirt after 'series of concussions'
news.description: USC linebacker Eric Gentry, who was leading the team in tackles and sacks through the first four games, will redshirt the rest of the 2024 season after suffering "a series of concussions in a short period of time."

news.headline: USC defensive end Anthony Lucas out for season
news.description: USC defensive end Anthony Lucas will miss the rest of the season due to a "lower extremity" injury, head coach Lincoln Riley announced Tuesday.

news.headline: Jeffery Simmons matches career high with 3 sacks in Bears' win
news.description: Jeffery Simmons recorded three sacks in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints on Sunday, which tied his single-game career high.

news.headline: Eagles' Riq Woolen benched after missed tackles vs. Steelers
news.description: Eagles cornerback Riq Woolen was benched in favor of veteran Jonathan Jones late in the first half of Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.

transactions.text: Placed LB Jack Campbell on injured reserve. Signed DB Nick Whiteside to the active roster. Elevated DE Anthony Lucas and RB Jabari Small from the practice squad.

Signed T Blake Miller, DE Derrick Moore, LB Jimmy Rolder, DB Keith Abney II, WR Kendrick Law and DTs Skyler Gill-Howard and Tyre West to rookie contracts. Signed QB Luke Altmyer, T Melvin Priestly, TE Miles Kitselman, DT Aidan Keanaaina, DEsAnthony Lucas and Eric O'Neil, DE Erick Hunter and DBs Aamaris Brown and De'Shawn Rucker to UDFA contracts.

insights: Entered the league in 2026 as an undrafted free agent.
